registration.title: Player ranks with club strength removed or weakened
registration.what: Three other forms of the player rating: before club scaling, with every club set level, and with club strength taken out by regression.
registration.why: Player ratings correlate strongly with club strength (0.60 for strikers to 0.77 for full-backs), which could mean they mostly repeat the club rank.
registration.how: Each form is used to predict players' future performance and minutes, and as the line-up input to match predictions, against the production form on the same rows.
registration.hypothesis: A rating less tied to club strength predicts players and matches better.
registration.success_criteria: At least 1% better on a player target's squared error, or 0.002 on match log loss, supported by intervals and both periods.

events.label: Scaled line-up over club controls, match log loss (the production form)
events.meaningful: The production form is the best of the four for matches; no alternative beats it, and none reaches 0.002.

events.reason: Unscaled and residual versions tie with the scaled one (differences of 0.003% of squared error or less). Keep club scaling.
